name: @ismail-elkorchi/html-parser
description: HTML parser with bounded text extraction, fragment parsing, and structural traversal.

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs test/behavior test/tooling && node scripts/test/compile-runtime-tests.mjs && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs tmp/test-runtime/test/engine && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.type-tests.json
scripts.test:behavior: npm run build && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs test/behavior
scripts.test:tooling: npm run build && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs test/tooling
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs tmp/test-runtime/test/engine
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build && npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/conformance/run-all.mjs
scripts.test:tokenizer: npm run build && npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/conformance/run-tokenizer-fixtures.mjs
scripts.test:engine:foundations: npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs tmp/test-runtime/test/engine/foundation
scripts.test:engine:tokenizer: npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs tmp/test-runtime/test/engine/tokenizer
scripts.test:engine:tree: npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/test/run-node-tests.mjs tmp/test-runtime/test/engine/tree
scripts.qualification:mutation: npm run build && npm run test:runtime:compile && node scripts/mutation/run.mjs
scripts.smoke:deno: npm run build && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=reports --allow-env scripts/smoke/control.mjs --runtime=deno --report=reports/smoke-deno.json
scripts.smoke:bun: npm run build && bun run scripts/smoke/control.mjs --runtime=bun --report=reports/smoke-bun.json
scripts.smoke:runtimes: npm run smoke:node && npm run smoke:deno && npm run smoke:bun
scripts.check:fast: npm run character-references:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:jsr && npm run test:architecture && npm test && node scripts/quality/check-public-surface.mjs && npm run docs:check && node scripts/quality/check-documentation-snippets.mjs && npm run docs:required && npm run docs:lint:jsr && npm run docs:test:jsr && node scripts/quality/check-text-safety.mjs && node examples/run-all.mjs
